description: Java class implementation for billing service logic in a banking application, providing CRUD operations for customers, accounts, and transactions, as well as fund transfer functionality.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of BankingService interface, providing methods for managing customers, accounts, and transactions within a banking application.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customer details from the repository, converted to domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record from provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Retrieves customer details for a specific customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information based on provided customer details and customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account details for a specific account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account for a specified customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs fund transfer between accounts for a customer, with balance validation and transaction recording.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches all transactions associated with a specific account number.
